title: cDNA Synthesis Protocol
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8hhht36
materials: use 200 ng of RNA for reaction
used directly or stored at -20° C

steps.title: Prepare cDNA synthesis reaction
steps.instruction: Use the BioRad iScript cDNA synthesis Kit (Cat.# 1708891) to set up the reverse transcription reaction according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Run reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 42 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Inactivate reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction at 85 °C for 5 min to inactivate the reverse transcriptase.
